+# Resolved mechanism identity, 2026-11-10
+
+The unfinished settings change now reports `cpu_bytes_to_use`,
+`eviction_policy="arc"` and `store_threshold` alongside the existing advice flag
+and absent semantic-scoring/GPU-prefetch mechanisms. The three added fields use
+`wait-hint-mechanisms-v1`; the existing response shape remains additive. Native
+ARC and the zero store threshold remain enforced during configuration and native
+scheduler construction. This changes observability, not retention behavior.
+
+Eight new pure cases cover advice enabled/disabled, two CPU byte budgets and
+explicit/default native policy settings. They also reject unsupported eviction
+and threshold values. Existing scheduler integration now asserts the entire
+mechanism identity in both advice modes during the real native store lifecycle.
+The authenticated HTTP/RPC test asserts the same resolved identity in its response.
+The portable test manifest gained exactly eight cases and removed none.
+
+## Executed checks
+
+- `uv run --offline --locked python tools/check.py --test tests/test_advice.py`:
+  14 passed; explicitly partial feedback.
+- `uv run --offline --locked python tools/check.py`: 174 passed; aggregate
+  9 groups passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. Native builds and the separate runtime
+  qualification lane remain skipped by this portable command.
+- Strict runtime mypy over `wait_hint_offload/vllm_adapter/*.py` and
+  `tests/runtime/*.py`, with `--follow-imports=silent --python-executable
+  /home/philip/.local/share/venvs/wait-hint-offload/bin/python`:
+  no issues in 12 source files.
+- The read-only pinned runtime launched the frozen source through
+  `python -B -m tools.run_runtime --timeout 300`, running all `tests/runtime`
+  with `tools.pytest_gate`, `runtime/cpu-tests.json` and `tools.runtime_capture`:
+  12 passed, 14 upstream deprecation warnings. Captured CUDA initialization was
+  false. Both advice modes and the actual HTTP/RPC method chain were exercised.
+
+All shell commands exported empty `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`; runtime commands also
+set `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`. Temporary files, logs and snapshots stayed in this
+assigned checkout. No runtime installation or modification, GPU execution or
+publication was performed. This execution used the attested launcher directly;
+it did not produce a new functional admission/terminal receipt. The full runtime
+source snapshot is retained as an archive with its per-file identity manifest.
+Every archived input and loaded product module hash was checked against that
+manifest after execution. Only documentation changed after the runtime snapshot.
+
+The first portable attempt had 173 passing tests and one repository-policy
+failure: concurrently created temporary fixture repositories and the runtime
+snapshot exposed additional AGENTS/CLAUDE files inside the checkout. The failed
+log is retained. The runtime snapshot was archived, and disposable fixtures moved
+to the existing ignored pytest-cache area before rerunning. The passing portable
+run used that cache area for temporary files; no acceptance policy was weakened.
+Disposable fixtures were removed after checks completed.
+
+These are CPU configuration/acknowledgement checks. They do not requalify hardware
+transfers, performance or answer quality. Raw logs and the archived snapshot stay
+in ignored `output/`; their immutable identities and tested source identities are
+below. The checkpoint remains local; no remote is configured or publication
+requested.
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enabled", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("capacity", [1024, 2048])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit", [False, True])
+def test_resolved_mechanisms(enabled: bool, capacity: int, explicit: bool) -> None:
+    raw: dict[str, object] = {
+        "namespace": Namespace("m", "t", "none", "dense-fp16").mapping(),
+        "cpu_bytes_to_use": capacity,
+        "advice_enabled": enabled,
+    }
+    if explicit:
+        raw.update(eviction_policy="arc", store_threshold=0)
+    settings = Settings.parse(raw)
+    assert settings.mechanisms() == {
+        "schema": "wait-hint-mechanisms-v1",
+        "cpu_bytes_to_use": capacity,
+        "eviction_policy": "arc",
+        "store_threshold": 0,
+        "cpu_arc_recency_advice": enabled,
+        "semantic_scoring": "absent",
+        "gpu_prefetch": "absent",
+    }
+    for invalid in ({"eviction_policy": "lru"}, {"store_threshold": 1}):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+            Settings.parse({**raw, **invalid})
